content.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
highlights: The guideline discusses the management of heart failure patients with various underlying conditions.
Emphasis on evidence from recent trials and meta-analyses related to cardiovascular health.
Addresses treatments including pharmacological interventions and lifestyle adjustments.
Importance of tailored therapy for patients with diabetes and cardiovascular diseases.
